data.name: Qr_Subtitle
data.value: Open the camera on your phone and point it at this code.

data.name: Qr_Footer
data.value: Paired phones reconnect on their own. Closing this window keeps Easy Mouse in the tray.

data.value: Easy Mouse is not listening, so there is no code to scan.

data.value: Your phone cannot reach this PC

data.name: Help_Intro
data.value: Nothing has connected for a while. This is usually one of these:

data.name: Help_IntroPublic
data.value: Easy Mouse stopped listening because of this:

data.name: Hint_Public_Title
data.value: This network is set to Public

data.name: Hint_Public_Body
data.value: Windows blocks other devices on Public networks. Setting it to Private fixes this.

data.name: Hint_Guest_Body
data.value: Some Wi-Fi networks keep devices apart on purpose, like guest networks and some hotel or office Wi-Fi. Try the main network.

data.name: Hint_Mobile_Body
data.value: Make sure the phone is on the same Wi-Fi as this PC.

data.name: Hint_Vpn_Title
data.value: A VPN is running on this PC

data.name: Hint_Vpn_Body
data.value: A VPN can hide this PC from your phone. Pause it, or choose the Wi-Fi or Ethernet card in Settings.

data.name: Hint_Cards_Title
data.value: This PC has more than one network card

data.name: Hint_Cards_Body
data.value: Easy Mouse uses {0}. If your phone is on another network, choose the right card in Settings.

data.name: Hint_NoNet_Title
data.value: This PC is not connected to a network

data.name: Hint_NoNet_Body
data.value: Connect to your Wi-Fi or plug in a cable, then try again.

data.name: Connected_Body
data.value: Easy Mouse is ready to use. The connection code is hidden and pairing is closed, so no new phone can join.

data.name: Help_PrivateFailed
data.value: The network was not changed. Windows needs your permission for this.

data.name: Ap_Body
data.value: A phone wants to control this PC. Allow it only if you started this just now.

data.name: Ap_Foot
data.value: The codes must match. You can remove this phone later in Devices.

data.name: Ap_TakeBody
data.value: This phone asks to take over. The phone that controls this PC now will be disconnected.

data.name: Ap_TakeFoot
data.value: Only one phone controls this PC at a time.

data.name: About_Line3
data.value: Phones control this PC over your own network only. Nothing goes through the internet.

data.name: Toast_ConnectedBody
data.value: It can now control this PC. Use Disconnect all in the tray to stop it.

data.name: Toast_EmergencyBody
data.value: Easy Mouse stopped listening. Use the tray menu to start again.

data.name: Toast_PublicBody
data.value: Easy Mouse stopped listening. Open the QR window to fix it.

data.name: Err_StoreTitle
data.value: Easy Mouse cannot read its device list

data.name: Err_StoreBody
data.value:
{0}
Easy Mouse does not start with an empty list, because that would silently unpair every phone. Move or delete that file to start over.

data.name: Upd_CheckDesc
data.value: Once a day Easy Mouse asks GitHub whether a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded or installed without your confirmation.

data.name: Upd_PreDesc
data.value: Also offer early test versions. They may be less stable.

data.name: Upd_Launching
data.value: The installer is running. Easy Mouse will restart when it finishes.

data.name: Upd_Confirm
data.value:
Download and install Easy Mouse {0}?
The installer is downloaded from GitHub and verified (signature and checksum) before it runs. Windows will ask for your permission, and Easy Mouse restarts when it is done.

data.name: Upd_Disclosure
data.value: Checking for updates is the only thing Easy Mouse does over the internet: a request to api.github.com and, only when you choose to update, a download from github.com. The requests carry no account, device or version information.

data.name: Upd_Err_Offline
data.value: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your internet connection and try again.

data.name: Upd_Err_RateLimited
data.value: GitHub asked for a pause. Try again after {0}.

data.name: Upd_Err_Http
data.value: GitHub gave an unexpected answer. Try again later.

data.name: Upd_Err_Malformed
data.value: The release information was not understood. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Upd_Err_Untrusted
data.value: The update was refused because it pointed somewhere that is not trusted. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Upd_Err_TooLarge
data.value: The update was refused because it is larger than expected. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Upd_Err_Signature
data.value: The update's signature is not valid, so it was not installed.

data.name: Upd_Err_Hash
data.value: The downloaded installer does not match its signed checksum, so it was not installed.

data.name: Upd_Err_Downgrade
data.value: The update was refused because it is not newer than this version.

data.name: Upd_Err_Installer
data.value: The installer could not be started. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Toast_UpdateBody
data.value: Easy Mouse {0} is ready. Open Settings, Updates, to install it.

data.name: Rm_Intro
data.value: Remotes are button layouts for your phone. Remotes that only press keys or control media run as they are. A remote that types text, opens websites, starts programs or contacts other devices stays off until you approve exactly what it does.

data.name: Rm_Hash
data.value: Your approval applies to this exact file (fingerprint {0}). If the file changes in any way, you are asked again.

data.name: Rm_Act_Text
data.value: types this text into the program in front ({0} characters): “{1}”

data.name: Rm_Act_Launch
data.value: starts the program you choose for “{0}”

data.name: Rm_Act_HttpOutside
data.value: a device or site outside this PC

data.name: Rm_Dangerous
data.value: Can start programs or contact other devices

data.name: Rm_Hosts
data.value: It will be allowed to contact: {0}

data.name: Rm_ImportReplaced
data.value: Updated “{0}”. Because the file changed, it needs your approval again if it has sensitive actions.

data.name: Rm_ImportSame
data.value: This exact remote is already imported.

data.name: Rm_ImportFailed
data.value: This file cannot be used as a remote:

data.name: Rm_ImportBuiltIn
data.value: A built-in remote already uses the id “{0}”. Change the id in the file and try again.

data.name: Rm_ImportOtherFile
data.value: The remote file {0} already uses the id “{1}”. Remove it or change the id.

data.name: Rm_ImportReadFail
data.value: The file could not be read: {0}

data.name: Rm_Omitted
data.value: These remotes do not fit on the phone screen yet, so the phone does not show them: {0}.
